local_stack.desc: Orchestrator-owned. Scratch copy of the repo (src, agent, reto-01, web, tsconfig.json, package.json, bunfig if any; node_modules symlinked), web/dist built with `bun run build:web` in the repo then copied. Fake LLM + production-mode server serving web/dist. 0 tokens.
local_stack.fake_llm: FAKE_LLM_PORT=4023 bun .qa/evidence/03-chat-web-api-sse-y-despliegue/seeds/03-fake-llm.ts  (routing: 'casos hay' -> listar; 'QA-TEXTO' -> multiline text; 'QA-LENTO' -> 4 s per call; 'QA-402|500|503' -> provider status; 'Sí, envía X' -> simular_envio confirmado; 'Cancela el envío de X' -> text; else leer/mapear/generar/armar per case id)
local_stack.server: cd $QA_SCRATCH/repo && PORT=3023 NODE_ENV=production LLM_PROVIDER=falso LLM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4023 LLM_MODEL=modelo-falso LLM_API_KEY=clave-falsa-qa-centinela LLM_FALLBACK_ENABLED=false ACCESS_CODE=codigo-local-de-prueba ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET=<synthetic 40 chars> FECHA_EJECUCION=2026-09-03 TZ_NEGOCIO=America/Bogota LOG_LEVEL=info bun --env-file=/dev/null src/server.ts
local_stack.variants: local_stack: base 3023 (fake 4023); variantes 3041 sin_clave, 3042 AGENT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET=1, 3043 proveedor 402 (fake 4043 FAKE_FORCE_STATUS=402), 3045 NEW_SESSIONS_PER_HOUR=1; la cookie 'acceso' sirve en todos los puertos (mismo ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET)
local_stack.runner_a_port: 3050 (aislado para T02r/T24r: el limitador de acceso no afecta al runner de navegador)
